components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string

The implementation is complete and the test suite passes. Here's a summary.

## What I changed

**Goal:** expose `telephoneDisplay` = the stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans (`+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`), while `telephone` stays raw E.164.

1. **New `util/Telephones.java`** — a single home for E.164 country-code knowledge. It provides:
   - `forDisplay(e164)` — splits off the recognized country calling code, then groups the national digits in threes: `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`.
   - `countryCode(e164)` and `isNationalLengthValid(e164)` — the country-code registry (`61`→9, `1`→10) and length check.

2. **Deleted `rest/function/owner/E164CountryLength.java`** and pointed `NormalizeOwnerTelephone` at `Telephones.isNationalLengthValid`. Rather than copy the country-code table into a second place, I moved the create-path length rule and the new display formatter onto one shared source of truth (behavior is identical). The rationale comment about lenient canonicalization vs. strict create-time length moved into `Telephones`' javadoc.

3. **`OwnerMapper`** — added a `telephoneDisplay(owner)` default method delegating to `Telephones.forDisplay(owner.getTelephone())`, wired via `@Mapping(target = "telephoneDisplay", ...)`, consistent with the other derived-field mappings. `telephone` is untouched, so it stays raw E.164.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `telephoneDisplay` string property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.

## Test results

- `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay` **passes**: `$.telephone` = `+61412345678`, `$.telephoneDisplay` = `+61 412 345 678`.
- Full `mvn test`: **1/1 pass, BUILD SUCCESS** (the repo's only test class is `AcceptanceTest`).

`mvn verify` fails on the JaCoCo coverage gate (line 0.21 vs. required 0.85). The new `Telephones` code is itself exercised by the passing acceptance test. I did not weaken the gate or pad it with synthetic tests. If you'd like, I can add focused unit tests for `Telephones` (and/or the owner pipeline) to move coverage toward the gate.
